Subject: Re: GatewayCorp access onboarding — SSO / SCIM questions + attachments

Alex / Priya,

Im Ben (infra lead) — quick technical checklist to prep the kickoff. Please reply inline where possible or attach files.

1) SAML metadata: we need the IdP metadata XML (entityID, signing cert, ACS URL will be provided by Redwood). If you use group claims, can you confirm the claim name (e.g., groups, memberOf)?
2) SAML attributes: can you map which groups correspond to Redwood roles (admin, developer, observer)? We support attribute-based role mapping during provisioning.
3) SCIM: do you push full user objects or just delta updates? Provide sample SCIM resource (user) or SCIM_schema_v2.json if available.
4) IP allowlist: we can accept CIDR ranges. The attached gateway_ip_allowlist.xlsx has preliminary ranges; we need egress/inbound separation. Specify which ranges are for staging vs prod.
5) Service accounts: we recommend creating distinct service accounts per pipeline. Please provide service_account_map.csv with owner and least privilege notes. Redwood will create matching service identities and emit key material via KMS-integration docs.
6) Audit/log retention: default retention is 90 days; enterprise can request 365 days for an additional retention add-on. Which retention does Gateway need?

Attachments referenced: SCIM_schema_v2.json (if available), GatewayCorp_SSO_App_Metadata.xml (IdP metadata).

Can the GatewayCorp team send the metadata + SCIM sample by Monday (13 Sep) so we can validate in staging before the Tue meeting?

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Lead, Inference Platform Operations
Redwood Inference

---
Ben Carter
Redwood Inference

- SCIM push is delta for changes; full user objects available on request. Our SCIM endpoint supports PATCH and PUT.
- Retention: compliance requires 365 days for auth/audit logs. Please include pricing add-on details.

Well plan to have our infra engineer (Alex) + security (me) on the Tue call. If theres anything missing, please flag.
